en: Grand Cross

Causes special damage [Light+Shadow/8 hits] to all
enemies near the target, ignoring elemental
resistance. (Cyclone/Luminaire/Charge)
Galactic Force

Unlocks the infinite power of the cosmos, causing
special damage [Null] to all enemies.
(Meteo/Cure/Vanish)
Peerless Power

Casts Physical Evasion and Repel Magic on all
allies. Also casts Provoke, attracting enemy attacks.
(Wall/Incite/Impenetrable Defense)
Evanescent Flash

Causes special damage [Light] to all enemies. Also
casts Restore on all allies, recovering their HP
automatically. (Aura/Play Dead/Echo)
Ultra Release

Causes special damage [Light+Shadow] to all
enemies near the target. Power increases according
to active status boosts. (Magen/Inspire/Pandemic)
Big Bang

Creates a blast with the power of cosmic creation,
causing special damage [Null/4 hits] to all
enemies. (Life/Demi/Booster)
Moments in Time

Causes special damage [Null/3 hits] to a single
enemy, and instantly fills the SP gauges of all allies.
(Realization/Flawless Blow/Emission)
Perpetual Strike

Deals countless blows in a single instant, causing
physical damage [Null/8 hits] to all enemies near
the target. (Radiance/Stop/Berserk)
Astral Stasis

Causes special damage [Null] to all enemies, and
inflicts Stop. Also boosts the ATB speed of all allies.
(Quick/All Creation/Stalker)
Apocalypse

Causes special damage [Null] to all enemies, and
boosts the Attack and Defense of all allies.
(Battlecry/Tenacity/Meltdown)
Hyperion

Causes special damage [Null] to all enemies near
the target. Inflicts more damage the higher HP/MP
are. (Cleave/Whirlwind Blade/Jump)
Stone Clutch

Causes special damage [Shadow/3 hits] to all
enemies near the target. Can also inflict Stone and
reduce stats. (Blade Wave/Stone Slash/Black Hole)
Stardust Fall

Summons a shower of stardust that causes special
damage [Fire+Water] to all enemies, ignoring
50% of Defense. (Shock/Enflame/Enfrost)
Detonation

Causes special damage [Fire] to all enemies in the
area near the target. Can also reduce Attack,
Defense, and ATB speed. (Spark/Dispel/Absorb)
Dragonic Ray

Causes special damage [Null] to all enemies, and
recovers the HP of all allies based on the user's
Strength. (Backslash/Chakra/Dragonic Soul)
Rising Phoenix

Causes special damage [Fire+Light/6 hits] to all
enemies, and casts Auto-Revive on all allies.

Causes special damage [Null/4 hits] to all enemies
near the target. Can also inflict Death.
(Sanctity/Oblivion/Counter)

A lightning-fast attack that causes special damage

Causes special damage [Null/11 hits] to all

Inflicts more damage when striking a weakness.
